summary: Anthropic announced the formation of a new AI services company with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, Goldman Sachs and other investors to deliver Claude-based solutions to mid-sized enterprises.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding Claude deployment to a new tier of mid-sized enterprises implies growing aggregate usage and token volume, as the company explicitly cites demand outpacing delivery capacity.
mechanisms.quote: Enterprise demand for Claude is significantly outpacing any single delivery model.
